            self.state_q99 = pre_stats.get(

    def _preprocess_image(self, img_np: np.ndarray) -> torch.Tensor:
        """HWC uint8 numpy → (1, C, H, W) float tensor ready for PI05."""

        q99 = self.state_q99[:D]
